nativeValidation.setup: Use a non-production Windows checkout with the stated source tree. Run the commands from its root in one non-elevated PowerShell 7 session on NTFS. Copy the probe after the first command. The tests create disposable junctions and hard links and need no symlink privilege.
commands: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false; if ((git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}').Trim() -ne '99e50103dd75a85daa28adf942cf4b94d59475a9') { throw 'Unexpected validation source tree' }; if ((go env GOOS).Trim() -ne 'windows') { throw 'Set Go to target native Windows' }; $scratch = (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.t3-tmp/windows-state-path' -Force).FullName; $temp = (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $scratch 'tmp') -Force).FullName; $env:TEMP = $temp; $env:TMP = $temp; $env:GOTMPDIR = $temp

$log = Join-Path $scratch 'native-main.log'; go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run=^(TestOpenServiceLogAppends|TestOpenServiceLogAllowsConcurrentRead|TestSetupServiceLogRejectsRootJunction|TestOpenServiceLogRejectsLeafJunction|TestOpenServiceLogRejectsHardLink)$' './cmds/ownsand-agent' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'native-main.log failed' }; $report = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw; foreach ($name in @('TestOpenServiceLogAppends','TestOpenServiceLogAllowsConcurrentRead','TestSetupServiceLogRejectsRootJunction','TestOpenServiceLogRejectsLeafJunction','TestOpenServiceLogRejectsHardLink')) { if ($report -notmatch ('(?m)^--- PASS: ' + [regex]::Escape($name) + ' \(')) { throw "$name did not pass" } }

$log = Join-Path $scratch 'native-store.log'; go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run=^(TestWindowsStateRejectsRootJunction|TestWindowsStateRejectsUntrustedRootOwner|TestWindowsStateRejectsFixedDirectoryJunctionBeforeOpen|TestWindowsStateChecksDeepJunctionOwner|TestOpenEnrollmentLockRejectsReparsePoint|TestOpenEnrollmentLockRejectsHardLink|TestOpenEnrollmentLockAcquiresRegularFile)$' './cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'native-store.log failed' }; $report = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw; foreach ($name in @('TestWindowsStateRejectsRootJunction','TestWindowsStateRejectsUntrustedRootOwner','TestWindowsStateRejectsFixedDirectoryJunctionBeforeOpen','TestWindowsStateChecksDeepJunctionOwner','TestOpenEnrollmentLockRejectsReparsePoint','TestOpenEnrollmentLockRejectsHardLink','TestOpenEnrollmentLockAcquiresRegularFile')) { if ($report -notmatch ('(?m)^--- PASS: ' + [regex]::Escape($name) + ' \(')) { throw "$name did not pass" } }

$log = Join-Path $scratch 'native-config-fallback.log'; go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run=^TestStartupDiagnosticForInvalidConfiguration$/^directory_creation_fails$' './cmds/ownsand-agent' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or (Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw) -notmatch '(?m)^\s+--- PASS: TestStartupDiagnosticForInvalidConfiguration/directory_creation_fails ') { throw 'Configuration fallback fixture did not pass' }

$probe = Join-Path $scratch 'windows-cli.ps1'; if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $probe).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne 'aebf3672ad726edf42b607f1f7d307da3d73b1f26271d963280ff32088d97041') { throw 'Unexpected probe contents' }; $agent = Join-Path $scratch 'ownsand-agent.exe'; go build '-o' $agent './cmds/ownsand-agent'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Agent build failed' }; & $probe -Agent $agent | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $scratch 'native-cli.log')
expectedResults: Every named standard-account fixture passes. The type, owner, junction and hard-link checks leave unrelated files and ACLs unchanged. The regular log still appends and permits concurrent reads.
The configuration-error test observes one redacted startup fallback and the expected usage status through the injected service dispatcher and event writer.
The native CLI probe reports PASS for run and reset. Both exit 1 with a reparse-point diagnostic. The target retains exactly the sentinel file with its original hash and DACL.
requiresElevation: Create and inspect the production SYSTEM and Administrators DACL, verify the first log entry on invalid configuration, upgrade legacy ACLs while retaining Hyper-V entries, and reset a trusted damaged root.
Real Windows service control and Application Event Log registration require elevated access on a disposable machine with no existing OwnSand service.

$log = Join-Path $scratch 'elevated-main.log'; go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run=^(TestSetupServiceLogProtectsNewStateDir|TestStartupDiagnosticForInvalidConfiguration|TestResetDeletesStateWhileServiceLogIsOpen)$' './cmds/ownsand-agent' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'elevated-main.log failed' }; $report = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw; foreach ($name in @('TestSetupServiceLogProtectsNewStateDir','TestStartupDiagnosticForInvalidConfiguration','TestResetDeletesStateWhileServiceLogIsOpen')) { if ($report -notmatch ('(?m)^--- PASS: ' + [regex]::Escape($name) + ' \(')) { throw "$name did not pass" } }

$log = Join-Path $scratch 'elevated-store.log'; go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run=^(TestOpenRestrictsStateDirACL|TestOpenCorrectsExistingStateDirACL|TestWipeLocalDataKeepsACL|TestOpenRejectsFixedSubdirectoryJunction|TestOpenKeepsTrustedDeepJunction|TestResetDirDeletesDamagedLayout|TestResetDirKeepsHeldLockAndStateUntilRetry|TestResetDirRejectsMalformedEnrollmentLock|TestResetDirAbsentDirectoryIsEmpty)$' './cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'elevated-store.log failed' }; $report = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw; foreach ($name in @('TestOpenRestrictsStateDirACL','TestOpenCorrectsExistingStateDirACL','TestWipeLocalDataKeepsACL','TestOpenRejectsFixedSubdirectoryJunction','TestOpenKeepsTrustedDeepJunction','TestResetDirDeletesDamagedLayout','TestResetDirKeepsHeldLockAndStateUntilRetry','TestResetDirRejectsMalformedEnrollmentLock','TestResetDirAbsentDirectoryIsEmpty')) { if ($report -notmatch ('(?m)^--- PASS: ' + [regex]::Escape($name) + ' \(')) { throw "$name did not pass" } }
elevatedExpectedResults: No elevated fixture skips. A new root has the protected two-principal DACL, its empty log inherits both entries before the first configuration error write, and the configuration-error path preserves the usage status.

Open rejects each fixed junction without touching its target. Reset clears the damaged layout and preserves the target. Open keeps a trusted deep junction. Older ACLs are corrected and Hyper-V entries stay.
requiresSymlinkPrivilege: Direct file symlink cases for the log and enrollment lock. These can run with symlink capability available through the elevated token or Windows Developer Mode.

symlinkExpectedResults: Both file symlink fixtures pass. Windows refuses the operation on the link itself and the log target stays intact.
unperformed: No SCM installation, real Event Log source registration, or Hyper-V execution was performed. Native service tests use the injected dispatcher and Event Log writer.
The validation host does not have elevation or symlink creation privilege. Leave positive protected-ACL and file-symlink acceptance pending unless run with the corresponding capabilities.
